text:
maria: Heads-up 15 - we need a final pass on landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private this afternoon. Deliverables: hero headline variants (A/B), primary CTA per mode, two-one-sentence benchmark narratives for social, and webinar CTA + inbound routing plan.

kevin: timeline? posts go live Tue morning. Webinar Fri 10am PT.

maria: yep, Tue publish. Email cadence starts Wed AM.

ash: I recommend two distinct benchmark angles so we can A/B across ads and threads:
- efficiency story: tokens-per-dollar vs vanilla cloud API (short stat + one-liner)
- resilience story: graceful degradation / fallbacks during load spikes (1-liner + micro-case)
Keep social blurbs <140 chars.

sam: draft CTAs (short):
- Hosted: "Try hosted API" -> instant API key (self-serve)
- Dedicated: "Get capacity quote" -> 2-step form (company + qps)
- Private: "Schedule security call" -> calendar + intake form
Also recommend adding a small hero subline for each that mentions the ask (e.g., "Reserve GPUs, predictable SLAs").

nina: hero headline variants (A / B)
- Hosted A: "Ship production LLM features with sub-50ms gen"
- Hosted B: "High-throughput hosted inference, zero infra overhead"
- Dedicated A: "Throughput you can commit to"
- Dedicated B: "Reserved GPU pools for steady-state inference"
- Private A: "Inference in your network, audited and controlled"
- Private B: "Bring inference behind your firewall with enterprise controls"

maria: Nice. Now inbound routing. We need deterministic routing so ops can wire flows. Sam?

sam: Proposed routing rules (keeps tags small):
```
form fields: company_name, company_size_bucket, use_case, expected_qps, compliance_needs (Y/N), desired_mode
if utm_source == 'ads' and desired_mode == 'Hosted' -> marketing_ops + tag: hosted-lead
if desired_mode == 'Dedicated' -> sdr_queue_capacity + tag: capacity-inquiry
if desired_mode == 'Private' and compliance_needs == 'Y' -> solutions_eng & enterprise_sales (high-touch)
if webinar_rsvp == true -> webinar_nurture_sequence -> if demo_requested -> sdr_queue_demo
```
UTM example: `?utm_source=launch_ad&utm_campaign=inference_launch_2026&utm_content=heroA`

maria: For form fields add a small gating question: "Do you require SOC2/SaaS data residency?" so we can route faster.

ash: For benchmark copy: two micro blurbs we can use on LinkedIn/Twitter + a 1-pager link.
- Efficiency: "Benchmarked: 3.7x tokens/$ vs baseline; median latency 22ms at 512 tokens. See our microbench." -> link to doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/bench/efficiency-2026
- Resilience: "During a simulated outage, auto-fallback kept 99.6% requests within SLA. Read the stress mini-case." -> https://docs.redwood.ai/bench/resilience-2026

kevin: Need the social creatives too. Nina can you produce 2 short headlines per blurb for ads?

nina: on it, will drop into Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique-figma-launch-stitches

launch-bot: Reminder: webinar Fri 10:00 PT. Registration page live. Auto-reminders: Wed 09:00 PT and Fri 08:30 PT.

maria: Action list (owners / due):
- nina: final ad headlines + Figma assets (today EOD)
- sam: routing rules + example form schema (today EOD)
- ash: 1-pager benchmark PDFs + short social blurbs (today EOD)
- kevin: schedule post calendar + channels (tomorrow AM)
- maria: compile launch post drafts once assets land, then quick review slot at 3pm.

sam: quick inline example for docs CTA (embed):
`curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"Say hi"}'`

maria: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers ping me in thread. We'll do a 15-min huddle at 3 if needed. :sparkles:
